Name: JerryBB's Sparkle Eye Collection
Author: JerryBBS2
Description:
[center][size=5][b]JerryBB's Sparkle Eye Collection[/b][/size]
[i]Seven hi-res eyes  ·  Eye Cover  ·  for Fashion Sense[/i][/center]

Seven sparkling hi-res eyes for Fashion Sense, drawn for the front and both side views, with an Eye Cover that hides the vanilla eyes underneath.

[b]The eyes[/b]
01 Fresh Emerald  ·  02 Starlit Night  ·  03 Quiet Night Sky  ·  04 Red Strawberry
05 Sweet Honeybee  ·  06 Violet Petal  ·  07 Clear Black

[b]Eye Cover[/b]
A small skin patch worn under the eyes. It hides the vanilla eyes and takes your character's own skin tone, so it works with every skin colour.

[b]What else they do[/b]
- [b]Fit every body:[/b] the framework finds where the eyes are on the body retexture you use (vanilla, GH, petite or short bodies and others) and moves the eyes and the cover there. You can fine-tune it in the settings.
- [b]Closed eyes:[/b] the eyes close while you lie in bed and when you pass out.
- [b]Status colours:[/b] when your farmer flashes a status colour (green when slimed, tipsy after beer or wine, and more), the eyes and the cover flash with it.

[size=3][b]IMPORTANT: install JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework 1.1.0[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55346]JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework[/url] 1.1.0 or newer is required. The eyes will not load without it.
It fits the eyes to your body, closes them in bed and passes status colours to them. If you have version 1.0.0, please update it.

[b]Requirements[/b]
- SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer
- Fashion Sense 7.0.0 or newer
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55346]JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework[/url] 1.1.0 or newer (REQUIRED)
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for the framework settings)

[b]Installation[/b]
1. Download one edition: English or Korean.
2. Download JerryBB's FS Outfit Framework 1.1.0 or newer.
3. Unzip both into your Mods folder. The eye pack zip has two folders (the eyes and the Eye Cover). Install both.

[b]How to wear[/b]
Open the Hand Mirror and use two accessory slots:
one for "JerryBB's Eye Cover" and one for the eyes you like.
Every item name starts with "JerryBB's".

[b]Files[/b]
- All seven eyes and the Eye Cover in one file.
- English and Korean editions. Install only one edition.

[b]Permissions[/b]
Do not upload translations or re-uploads of this mod without my permission.
Unauthorized translations and re-uploads will be reported.

[b]Thank you[/b]
Big thanks to every creator who made this possible:

ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley.
Pathoschild for SMAPI and Content Patcher.
PeacefulEnd for Fashion Sense. These eyes could not exist without it.
spacechase0 for Generic Mod Config Menu.
GH for GH's Peach Tall Body type, the body these eyes were first drawn on.

[center]Thank you for downloading, and have fun!  - JerryBB[/center]
